rows.source_ko: 제2조(경과조치) ① 이 규칙 시행 전의 위반행위에 대한 행정처분기준은 별표 5의 개정규정 중 1차 위반행위의 행정처분기준에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures)  ① The standards for administrative dispositions for violations committed prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be in accordance with the standards for administrative dispositions for first-time violations among the amended provisions of Annex 5.

rows.source_ko: ② 별표 5의 개정규정에 따라 위반행위의 횟수에 따른 행정처분기준을 적용하는 경우 이 규칙 시행 후에 최초로 한 위반행위를 1차의 위반행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② When applying the standards for administrative dispositions based on the number of violations pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 5, the first violation committed after the enforcement of this rule shall be deemed the first violation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs Decree No. 135, June 16, 2009>

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(어린이통학버스의 신고에 관한 적용례) 별표 4 제1호나목3)라)의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 후 최초로 운송계약을 체결하는 자부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Reporting of School Buses for Children)  The amended provisions of Subparagraph 3)d) of Item 1 (b) of Annex 4 shall apply to those who enter into a transportation contract for the first time after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(경과조치) 법 제59조에 따른 연합회는 종전의 제42조제4항에 따른 전산정보처리조직으로 유지ㆍ관리 및 보관 중인 전산자료를 교통안전공단으로 이관하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures)  The Association pursuant to Article 59 of the Act shall transfer computer data maintained, managed, and stored by the computer information processing organization pursuant to the former Article 42, Paragraph 4 to the Korea Transportation Safety Authority.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs Decree No. 170, Oct. 9, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs Decree No. 184, Dec. 2, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 4의 제1호가목13) 및 같은 호 나목2)바)의 개정규정은 공포 후 1년이 경과한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Item 1, Subparagraph (a) 13) and Item 2), Subparagraph (b) f) of Annex 4 shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(운행정보 수집ㆍ저장 장치 및 기록 보존의 시범운영) 택시운송사업용 자동차의 운행정보를 수집ㆍ저장하고 정보의 조작을 막을 수 있는 장치의 설치 및 운행정보의 기록 보존을 효과적으로 시행하기 위하여 국토해양부장관이 정하는 지역에서는 이 규칙을 공포한 날부터 1년 이내의 기간동안 시범운영을 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Pilot Operation of Operation Information Collection and Storage Devices and Record Preservation)  In order to effectively implement the collection and storage of operation information of vehicles used for taxi transportation business, the installation of devices capable of preventing manipulation of information, and the record preservation of operation information, a pilot operation may be conducted in areas designated by the Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs for a period of up to one year from the date of promulgation of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(택시운송사업의 구분 변경에 따른 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따라 중형으로 분류된 1,500씨씨 이상 1,600씨씨 미만의 택시운송사업용 승용자동차는 제9조제2호의 개정규정에 불구하고 이 규칙을 공포한 날부터 2년 동안 이 규칙에 따른 중형의 택시운송사업용 승용자동차로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Following Change in Classification of Taxi Transport Business)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 9, Subparagraph 2, passenger vehicles for taxi transport business with an engine displacement of 1,500cc or more and less than 1,600cc, which were classified as medium-sized under the previous regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, shall be deemed to be medium-sized passenger vehicles for taxi transport business under this Rule for a period of two years from the date of promulgation of this Rule.

rows.text_en: ⑥ The Enforcement Rules of the Passenger Motor Vehicle Transport Business Act are amended as follows.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(자동차대여사업자의 보유 차고 면적기준에 대한 적용례) 별표 6의 비고란 제2호의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 후 최초로 신규등록 또는 변경등록하는 자동차대여사업자부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Garage Area Standards for Automobile Rental Business Operators)  The amended provisions of Item 2 of the Note column in Annex 6 shall apply to automobile rental business operators who register a new business or change their registration for the first time after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(직행형인 시외버스운송사업자의 사업계획 변경에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따라 직행형인 시외버스운송사업의 면허를 받은 자는 이 규칙 시행 후 1년 이내에 제8조제5항제2호의 개정규정에 적합하도록 법 제10조에 따라 사업계획을 변경하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Changes to Business Plans of Express Intercity Bus Operators)  Persons who have obtained a license for an express intercity bus transportation business under the previous regulations at the time of enforcement of this Rule shall change their business plan in accordance with Article 10 of the Act within one year after enforcement of this Rule to comply with the amended provisions of Article 8, Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 2.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(자동차대여사업의 등록기준에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 자동차대여사업의 등록 또는 사업계획 변경등록을 한 경우에는 별표 6의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Registration Standards for Automobile Rental Business)  In cases where an automobile rental business registration or a change of business plan registration was made prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the previous regulations shall apply notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 6.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제17조제1항, 같은 조 제2항, 제27조제1항 및 별표 1의 개정규정은 2015년 1월 29일부터 시행하고, 제49조제3항제3호 및 같은 조 제6항의 개정규정은 2016년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 17, Paragraph 1, Paragraph 2, Article 27, Paragraph 1, and Annex 1 shall enter into force on January 29, 2015, and the amended provisions of Article 49, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 and Paragraph 6 of the same article shall enter into force on January 1, 2016.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(자격유지검사에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 제49조제3항제3호의 개정규정에 따른 자격유지검사 대상이 된 사람은 제49조제6항의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2017년 1월 1일까지 자격유지검사를 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Qualification Maintenance Examination)  Persons who were subject to the qualification maintenance examination pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 49, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 at the time of enforcement of this Rule shall undergo the qualification maintenance examination by January 1, 2017, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 49, Paragraph 6.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(유상운송용 자가용자동차의 차령 연장에 관한 적용례) 제103조의2제3항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전 정기검사를 받은 자동차에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to the Extension of the Vehicle Age for Private Vehicles Used for Commercial Transport)  The amended provisions of Article 103-2, Paragraph 3 shall also apply to vehicles that underwent periodic inspection prior to the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(유치원ㆍ어린이집ㆍ학원 또는 체육시설 통학용 자동차의 차령에 관한 특례) ① 법 제81조제1항제2호 및 이 규칙 제103조제4호의2의 개정규정에 따라 이 규칙 시행일부터 2018년 12월 31일까지 자가용자동차의 유상운송 허가를 하는 경우에는 제103조제4호의2다목의 개정규정에 따른 차령요건을 적용하지 아니할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Special provisions regarding the age of vehicles used for school transportation to kindergartens, daycare centers, private academies, or sports facilities)  ① In cases where permission for paid transportation by private vehicles is granted from the enforcement date of this Rule until December 31, 2018, in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 81, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act and Article 103, Subparagraph 4-2 of this Rule, the age requirement under the amended provisions of Article 103, Subparagraph 4-2, Item (c) may not be applied.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 제103조제4호의2다목의 개정규정에 따른 차령요건을 갖추지 아니하고 허가를 받은 자가 2019년 1월 1일 이후에도 자가용자동차의 유상운송을 하려는 경우에는 제104조제2항에도 불구하고 2018년 12월 31일까지 제103조제4호의2다목의 개정규정에 따른 차령요건을 갖추어 자가용자동차의 유상운송에 관한 갱신허가를 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If a person who has obtained a permit without meeting the vehicle age requirements under the amended provisions of Article 103, subparagraph 4-2, subparagraph c, intends to continue providing paid transportation using a private vehicle after January 1, 2019, notwithstanding Article 104, paragraph 2, he/she must meet the vehicle age requirements under the amended provisions of Article 103, subparagraph 4-2, subparagraph c, by December 31, 2018, and obtain a renewal permit for the paid transportation using a private vehicle.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(유치원 통학용 자동차의 유상운송 허가에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 제103조제4호에 따른 허가를 받은 「유아교육법」 제2조제2호에 따른 유치원의 통학용 자동차는 제103조제4호의2의 개정규정에 따른 허가를 받은 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Permission for Paid Transportation by Vehicles for Kindergarten School Commuting)  Vehicles for kindergarten school commuting under Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Early Childhood Education Act, which were granted permission pursuant to Subparagraph 4 of the former Article 103 at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, shall be deemed to have obtained permission pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 103, Subparagraph 4-2.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, in the case of the amended provisions of Article 9, subparagraph 4 and Annex 1, subparagraph 3, they shall enter into force on January 1, 2019 for business areas other than Special Cities and Metropolitan Cities.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(행정처분기준에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전의 위반행위에 대한 행정처분기준에 관하여는 별표 5 제2호나목11)다)의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Standards for Administrative Dispositions)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Subparagraph 11)c) of Item 2, Subparagraph b) of Annex 5 regarding standards for administrative dispositions for violations committed prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the former provisions shall apply.

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Amendment of the Enforcement Rule of the Passenger Transport Service Act)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 60, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5, business plans submitted prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be governed by the former provisions.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제10조제3항부터 제5항까지 및 제98조제1항의 개정규정은 2017년 1월 20일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 10, Paragraphs 3 through 5 and Article 98, Paragraph 1 shall enter into force on January 20, 2017.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사업구역 조정신청에 관한 적용례) 제10조제3항제2호, 같은 조 제4항ㆍ제5항 및 제98조제1항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 사업구역에 관한 조정신청을 하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Applications for Adjustment of Business Areas)  The amended provisions of Article 10, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2, Paragraphs 4 and 5 of the same article, and Article 98, Paragraph 1 shall apply from the time an application for adjustment of a business area is made after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(운전자격시험 필기시험 일부 면제 신청에 관한 적용례) 제54조제3항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 운전자격시험 응시원서를 제출한 자에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applicability to Applications for Partial Exemption from the Written Test of the Driver Qualification Examination)  The amended provisions of Article 54, Paragraph 3 shall also apply to persons who submitted an application for the driver qualification examination prior to the enforcement of this Rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 406, Feb. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제58조제3항ㆍ제7항ㆍ제8항 및 제107조제1항 후단의 개정규정은 공포 후 6개월이 경과한 날부터 시행하고, 별표 4 제1호가목15) 및 21)의 개정규정은 공포 후 3개월이 경과한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 58, Paragraphs 3, 7, and 8, and the latter part of Article 107, Paragraph 1 shall enter into force six months after the date of promulgation, and the amended provisions of Annex 4, Item 1, Subparagraph (a), 15) and 21) shall enter into force three months after the date of promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(운송개시의 기일 연기 등에 관한 적용례) 제25조제3항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 운송개시의 기일 연기 또는 기간 연장 신청을 한 자에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Postponement of Commencement of Transport, etc.)  The amended provisions of Article 25, Paragraph 3 shall also apply to persons who applied for a postponement of the commencement of transport or an extension of the period prior to the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(운행기록증 발부 현황 자료 보관에 관한 적용례) 제44조의5제3항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 발부하는 운행기록증부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applicability to the Storage of Data on the Status of Issuance of Driving Record Certificates)  The amended provisions of Article 44-5, Paragraph 3 shall apply to driving record certificates issued after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(법령위반 운수종사자 교육 시기에 관한 적용례) 별표 4의3 제1호의 비고 제4호의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 과태료, 과징금 또는 사업정지처분을 받은 자부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Applicability to the timing of education for transport workers violating laws and regulations)  The amended provisions of Note 4 of Item 1 of Annex 4-3 shall apply to those who have received a fine, penalty surcharge, or business suspension order after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(행정처분기준에 관한 적용례) 별표 5 제2호가목7)의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 발생한 위반행위에 대하여 행정처분을 하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Applicability to Standards for Administrative Dispositions)  The amended provisions of Subparagraph 2, Item (a) 7) of Annex 5 shall apply from the time an administrative disposition is imposed for a violation that occurred after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(운수종사자 교육시간에 대한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전의 위반행위로 과태료, 과징금 또는 사업정지처분을 받은 자 및 이 규칙 시행 전에 특별검사 대상이 된 자에 관하여는 별표 4의3 제1호나목의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Transitional Measures Regarding Training Hours for Transport Workers)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Subparagraph 1, Item (b) of Annex 4-3, persons who received a fine, penalty surcharge, or business suspension order for a violation committed prior to the enforcement of this Rule, and persons who became subject to a special inspection prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the previous provisions shall apply.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(행정처분기준에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전의 위반행위에 대한 행정처분에 관하여는 별표 5 제2호가목4)의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Transitional Measures Concerning Standards for Administrative Dispositions)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Subparagraph 2, Item (a) 4) of Annex 5, regarding administrative dispositions for violations committed prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the former provisions shall apply.

rows.text_en: ② The Enforcement Rules of the Passenger Transport Service Act are partially amended as follows.

rows.text_en: In Article 10, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 and Article 64, Paragraph 2, “Aviation Act” shall be changed to “Aviation Business Act”.

rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 94-3 shall enter into force on June 3, 2017.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제44조의6, 제45조 및 별지 제23호의5서식부터 제23호의8서식까지의 개정규정은 2018년 4월 25일부터, 제33조 및 제49조의 개정규정은 공포 후 1년이 경과한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 44-6, Article 45, and Forms No. 23-5 through No. 23-8 shall enter into force on April 25, 2018, and the amended provisions of Article 33 and Article 49 shall enter into force one year after the date of promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(휴식시간에 관한 유효기간) 별표4 제1호라목 및 제2호파목은 2018년 4월 24일까지 효력을 가진다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Validity Period Regarding Rest Time)  Subparagraph 1(d) and Subparagraph 2(f) of Annex 4 shall remain in effect until April 24, 2018.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(자격유지검사에 관한 특례) 부칙 제1조 단서에 따른 시행일 당시 제49조제3항의 개정규정에 따른 자격유지검사 대상이 된 운수종사자는 제49조제7항에도 불구하고 시행 후 1년 이내에 자격유지검사를 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Special provisions regarding qualification maintenance examination)  Transport workers who were subject to the qualification maintenance examination under the amended provisions of Article 49, Paragraph 3 at the time of enforcement pursuant to the proviso of Article 1 of the Addenda shall undergo the qualification maintenance examination within one year after enforcement, notwithstanding Article 49, Paragraph 7.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(사업면허 신청 등에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 여객운송사업 면허ㆍ등록을 신청한 자는 제12조 및 제22조의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Application for Business License, etc.)  Persons who applied for a passenger transport business license or registration before the enforcement of this Rule shall be subject to the former provisions notwithstanding the amended provisions of Articles 12 and 22.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(사업계획의 변경에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 택시운송사업의 구분 변경 인가를 신청한 자는 제33조의 개정규정에 따른 신고를 한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Transitional Measures Concerning Changes to Business Plans)  Any person who applied for approval of a change in the classification of a taxi transportation business prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have filed a report pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 33.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(여객자동차터미널 시설사용료 인가 등에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 여객자동차터미널 시설사용료 인가나 변경인가를 신청한 자는 제80조의 개정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Transitional Measures concerning Authorization, etc. of Passenger Automobile Terminal Facility Usage Fees)  Persons who applied for authorization or modification authorization of passenger automobile terminal facility usage fees before the enforcement of this Rule shall be subject to the former provisions notwithstanding the amendment of Article 80.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 526, June 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제43조의2의 개정규정은 2019년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 43-2 shall enter into force on January 1, 2019.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(특수여객자동차운송사업의 등록기준 대수 조정에 관한 적용례) 별표 3의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 후 특수여객자동차운송사업의 등록을 신청하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to the Adjustment of the Registration Standard Number of Vehicles for Special Passenger Transport Businesses)  The amended provisions of Annex 3 shall apply from the time an application for registration of a special passenger transport business is made after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: In Article 13, subparagraph 1, “the Railway Construction Act” shall be changed to “the Act on the Construction of Railways and Maintenance of Railway Facilities”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2021년 1월 1일부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 6의2의 개정규정은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on January 1, 2021. However, the amended provisions of Annex 6-2 shall enter into force on the date of promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(교통안전교육에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 한국교통안전공단이 실시하는 교통안전체험, 교통사고 대응요령과 여객자동차 운수사업법령 등에 관한 이론 및 실기교육을 이수한 경우에는 제19조제9항제2호의 개정규정에 따른 교통안전교육을 이수한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Traffic Safety Education)  In the event that a person has completed theoretical and practical training on traffic safety experience, traffic accident response procedures, and the Passenger Transport Service Act and related regulations conducted by the Korea Transportation Safety Authority prior to the enforcement of this Rule, such person shall be deemed to have completed the traffic safety education pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 19, Paragraph 9, Subparagraph 2.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 716, Apr. 14, 2020>

rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on January 1, 2021. However, the amended provisions of Article 112 shall enter into force on May 14, 2020.

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Enforcement Rules of the Passenger Transport Service Act are partially amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제70조의2 각 호 외의 부분 및 같은 조 제1호 중 “「자동차관리법 시행규칙」 제41조제1항”을 각각 “「자동차관리법 시행규칙」 제41조제2항”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 70-2 and in subparagraph 1 of the same article, “Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rules of the Automobile Management Act” shall be changed to “Article 41, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Automobile Management Act”.

ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 891, Sep. 24, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2021년 9월 24일부터 시행한다. 다만, 제17조제1항제4호, 같은 조 제2항 및 별표 6 비고 제6호의 개정규정은 2022년 3월 24일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on September 24, 2021. However, the amended provisions of Article 17, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4, Paragraph 2 of the same Article, and Note 6 of Annex 6 shall enter into force on March 24, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(택시운송사업의 한정면허에 관한 적용례) 제17조제1항제4호 및 제2항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 한정면허를 하기 위하여 같은 조 제2항 각 호의 사항을 공고하는 등 공개적인 방법으로 그 대상자를 선정하고자 하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Limited Licenses for Taxi Transportation Businesses)  The amended provisions of Article 17, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 and Paragraph 2 shall apply from the time when the subjects are to be selected by public means, such as by announcing the matters specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 of the same article, in order to grant a limited license after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(자동차대여사업의 등록기준에 관한 적용례) 제60조제1항제3호, 제65조제1항제2호가목, 제66조제1항제3호 및 별표 6의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 자동차대여사업의 등록 또는 사업계획 변경등록을 신청하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applicability to Registration Standards for Automobile Rental Business)  The amended provisions of Article 60, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3, Article 65, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item (a), Article 66, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3, and Annex 6 shall apply from the time of application for registration of an automobile rental business or registration of a change in business plan after the enforcement of this rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1102, Jan. 28, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2022년 1월 28일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on January 28, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(개인택시운송사업의 양도ㆍ양수 제한 사유에 관한 적용례) 제35조제7항나목의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 「도로교통법」 제93조제1항제1호에 해당하여 운전면허효력 정지처분을 받은 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Grounds for Restriction on Transfer and Assignment of Individual Taxi Transportation Businesses)  The amended provisions of Article 35, Paragraph 7, Subparagraph (b) shall apply from the time a driver's license suspension order is received in accordance with Article 93, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Road Traffic Act after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <국토교통부령 제1118호, 2022. 3. 30.> (국민 편의를 높이는 서식 정비를 위한 17개 법령의 일부개정에 관한 국토교통부령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1118, Mar. 30, 2022> (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree on the Partial Amendment of 17 Laws for the Improvement of Forms to Enhance Public Convenience)

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1128, June 8, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제44조의5, 별표 4, 별지 제23호의2서식 및 별지 제23호의3서식의 개정규정은 2022년 9월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 44-5, Annex 4, Form No. 23-2 and Form No. 23-3 shall enter into force on September 1, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(운행정보 신고에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 운행정보를 신고한 경우에는 제44조의5, 별지 제23호의2서식 및 제23호의3서식의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Reporting of Operation Information)  In cases where operation information was reported prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the former provisions shall apply notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 44-5, Forms 23-2 and 23-3 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(유상운송 허가 등의 처리기간에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 유상운송 또는 유상임대 허가를 신청한 경우 그 처리기간에 대해서는 별지 제51호서식 및 제52호서식의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Processing Period for Permission for Paid Transportation, etc.)  In cases where an application for permission for paid transportation or paid leasing was submitted prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the processing period shall be governed by the former regulations, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Forms No. 51 and No. 52.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1204, Apr. 18, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포 후 6개월이 경과한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사업계획 변경신고 대상 변경에 관한 경과조치 등) ① 이 규칙 시행 전에 종전의 제33조제1항제6호에 따라 택시운송사업의 구분 변경을 위한 사업계획 변경 인가를 신청한 경우로서 인가 절차가 진행 중인 경우에는 제33조제1항제6호의 개정규정에 따라 택시운송사업의 구분 변경을 위한 사업계획 변경 신고서를 이 규칙 시행일에 제출한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures, etc. concerning Changes in the Subject of Reporting Changes to Business Plans)  ① In cases where an application for approval of a change in business plan for a change in the classification of a taxi transportation business was made pursuant to Subparagraph 6 of the former Article 33, Paragraph 1 prior to the enforcement of this Rule, and the approval procedure is in progress, the report on the change in business plan for a change in the classification of a taxi transportation business shall be deemed to have been submitted on the enforcement date of this Rule pursuant to the amended provisions of Subparagraph 6 of Article 33, Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ② 관할관청은 제1항에 따라 택시운송사업의 구분 변경을 위한 사업계획 변경 신고서를 제출한 것으로 보는 경우 이 규칙 시행일부터 5일 내에 신고수리 여부를 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the competent authority deems that a report on a change of business plan for a change in the classification of a taxi transportation business has been submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1, it shall notify whether the report has been accepted within 5 days from the effective date of this rule.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(대여자동차의 편도이용에 관한 적용례) 제64조제3항의 개정규정은 이 법 시행 당시 주사무소 또는 영업소를 달리하여 반환되어 있는 자동차(15일을 초과하여 반환된 주사무소 또는 영업소에 상시 주차되어 있는 경우는 제외한다)에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to One-Way Use of Rental Vehicles)  The amended provisions of Article 64, Paragraph 3 shall also apply to vehicles that have been returned to a different principal office or business office at the time of the enforcement of this Act (excluding cases where the vehicle is permanently parked at the principal office or business office to which it was returned for more than 15 days).
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1291, Dec. 21, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(소화물의 부피 및 무게에 관한 적용례) 제40조의3제1항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 소화물을 운송하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Volume and Weight of Small Parcels)  The amended provisions of Article 40-3, Paragraph 1 shall apply to cases where small parcels are transported after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사업계획의 변경신고에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 접수된 사업계획의 변경신고에 대해서는 제33조제8항 및 별지 제15호서식의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Notification of Change of Business Plan)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 33, Paragraph 8 and Form No. 15, notifications of change of business plan received prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be governed by the former provisions.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(유상운송용 자가용자동차의 차령 연장에 관한 특례) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 제103조의2에 따른 차령이 10년 6개월 이상인 자동차로서 차령 기간이 31일 이내로 남은 유상운송용 자가용자동차는 이 규칙 시행 이후 「자동차관리법」 제43조제1항제2호에 따른 정기검사(이하 “정기검사”라 한다)를 같은 법에 따른 검사기간 내에 받은 경우에는 이 규칙 제103조의2제3항에 따른 차령연장을 위한 정기검사를 받은 것으로 본다. 이 경우 정기검사를 받아 차령이 연장되기 전까지는 해당 자동차를 종전의 규정에 따라 연장된 차령 기간을 넘겨서 유상운송용으로 제공할 수 없다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Special Provisions on the Extension of the Age of Private Vehicles for Commercial Transportation)  A private vehicle for commercial transportation that, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, has an age of 10 years and 6 months or more pursuant to the former Article 103-2 and has a remaining age period of 31 days or less, shall be deemed to have undergone the periodic inspection for the extension of the age pursuant to Article 103-2, Paragraph 3 of this Rule if, after the enforcement of this Rule, it undergoes the periodic inspection pursuant to Article 43, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Automobile Management Act (hereinafter referred to as “periodic inspection”) within the inspection period pursuant to the same Act. In this case, until the age is extended by undergoing the periodic inspection, the vehicle may not be provided for commercial transportation beyond the extended age period pursuant to the former regulations.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(특정 유상운송용 자가용자동차의 차령에 관한 특례) ① 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 충족하는 자동차로서 이 규칙 시행 전에 받은 정기검사 중 가장 최근에 받은 검사의 유효기간이 만료되지 않은 유상운송용 자가용자동차는 해당 검사유효기간의 만료일까지 제103조의2의 개정규정에 따른 차령이 추가로 부여된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Special Provisions Concerning the Age of Private Vehicles for Specific Commercial Transport)  ① Private vehicles for commercial transport that satisfy all of the requirements of the following subparagraphs and for which the validity period of the most recent periodic inspection received prior to the enforcement of this Rule has not yet expired shall be deemed to have been additionally granted an age in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 103-2 until the expiration of the said inspection validity period.

rows.source_ko: 1. 종전의 제103조의2에 따른 차령이 10년 6개월 이상인 자동차
rows.text_en: 1. Vehicles with a vehicle age of 10 years and 6 months or more pursuant to the former Article 103-2

rows.source_ko: 2. 2023년 7월 3일 이후부터 이 규칙 시행 전까지의 기간에 종전의 제103조의2에 따른 차령이 만료된 자동차
rows.text_en: 2. Vehicles whose age limit under the former Article 103-2 has expired during the period from July 3, 2023, until the enforcement of this Rule

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 당시 제1항 각 호에 따른 자동차 중 가장 최근 받은 정기검사의 검사유효기간이 만료된 자동차는 이 규칙 시행 이후 받는 정기검사의 검사유효기간만큼 제103조의2의 개정규정에 따른 차령이 새로 부여된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② For vehicles subject to each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 at the time of enforcement of this Rule, for which the validity period of the most recent periodic inspection has expired, a new vehicle age pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 103-2 shall be deemed to have been assigned for an amount equal to the validity period of the periodic inspection received after enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 정기검사를 받아 차령이 추가로 부여되기 전까지는 해당 자동차를 종전의 규정에 따라 연장된 차령 기간을 넘겨서 유상운송용으로 제공할 수 없으며, 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 차령이 추가로 부여되는 경우에도 제103조의2제4항의 개정규정에 따른 최대 차령을 넘겨 해당 자동차를 유상운송용으로 제공할 수 없다.
rows.text_en: ③ Until a periodic inspection is conducted in accordance with Paragraphs 1 and 2 and an additional vehicle age limit is granted, the vehicle in question may not be provided for paid transportation beyond the extended vehicle age limit period under the previous regulations; and even if an additional vehicle age limit is granted in accordance with Paragraphs 1 and 2, the vehicle in question may not be provided for paid transportation beyond the maximum vehicle age limit under the amended provisions of Article 103-2, Paragraph 4.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to refresher training for transport workers)  The amended provisions of Subparagraph 1, Item 2) of Annex 4-3 shall apply from the time refresher training is conducted after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따라 발급된 운전자격증, 운수종사자 교육카드 및 검사공무원증은 별지 제30호서식, 별지 제32호서식 및 별지 제50호서식의 개정규정에도 불구하고 계속하여 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Forms)  Driver's qualification certificates, transportation worker training cards, and inspection officer identification cards issued under the previous regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule may continue to be used notwithstanding the amended provisions of Forms No. 30, No. 32, and No. 50.

rows.text_en:
[Attached Table 1] Types of Vehicles Used in Passenger Motor Vehicle Transportation Business (Related to Article 7)

Vehicle Types Used in Passenger Transport Services (Annex 1, Article 7)

| Service category | Permitted vehicle type and conditions |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Urban and rural bus services | A medium-sized or larger bus. A small-sized or larger bus may be used for rural bus services where approved by the competent authority. Urban seated buses on metropolitan express, direct-seated, or seated routes must have installed seats; general urban buses may have both seats and standing spaces. |
| 2. Intercity bus services | A medium-sized or large bus. Classified by operation type as follows: |
| a. Deluxe express intercity bus | A large bus on an express route, engine output at least 20 horsepower per metric ton of gross vehicle weight, and seating capacity of no more than 29. |
| b. Express intercity bus | A large bus on an express route, at least 20 horsepower per metric ton, and seating capacity of at least 30. |
| c. Premium express intercity bus | A large bus on an express route, at least 20 horsepower per metric ton, and seating capacity of no more than 22. |
| d. Deluxe direct intercity bus | A large bus on a direct route, at least 20 horsepower per metric ton, and seating capacity of no more than 29. |
| e. Direct intercity bus | A medium-sized or larger bus on a direct route. |
| f. Premium direct intercity bus | A large bus on a direct route, at least 20 horsepower per metric ton, and seating capacity of no more than 22. |
| g. Deluxe general intercity bus | A large bus on a general route, at least 20 horsepower per metric ton, and seating capacity of no more than 29. |
| h. General intercity bus | A medium-sized or larger bus on a general route. |
| 3. Taxi services | A passenger car; or a passenger van with engine displacement of at least 2,000 cc and seating capacity of no more than 13, or a qualifying eco-friendly vehicle specified in Article 2(3) through (6) of the Act on Promotion of Development and Distribution of Environment-Friendly Motor Vehicles with seating capacity of no more than 13. |
| 4. Village bus services | A medium-sized bus, or a small or large bus where approved by the competent authority. |
| 5. Chartered bus services | A medium-sized or larger bus with seating capacity of at least 16. |
| 6. Special passenger services | A special-purpose passenger van or passenger car, distinguished as ordinary funeral vehicles and hearse-only funeral vehicles. |
| 7. Demand-responsive passenger transport services | A passenger car or a small-sized or larger bus. |

Notes
1. In areas designated and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, urban/rural buses, intercity buses, village buses, and chartered buses may use a small electric bus seating at least 13 persons under Article 2(3) of the Act on Promotion of Development and Distribution of Environment-Friendly Motor Vehicles, notwithstanding the table.
2. For a limited license under Article 17(1)3, a bus seating at least 11 persons must be used, notwithstanding the table.

rows.source_ko: [별표 6의3] 플랫폼가맹사업의 면허기준(제93조의10 관련)
rows.text_en:
[Attached Table 6-3] Licensing Standards for Platform Franchise Business (Related to Article 93-10)

Licensing Standards for Platform Franchise Businesses (Annex 6-3, Article 93-10)

1. Minimum number of vehicles operated by transportation franchisees:

| Size of business area | Minimum secured vehicles |
| --- | --- |
| a. Special City or Metropolitan City | At least 1% of the combined number of vehicles used for general and individual taxi transport services in the area, or at least 500 vehicles. |
| b. Business area with population of at least 500,000 | At least 1.5% of the combined vehicles used for general and individual taxi services in the area. |
| c. Business area with population below 500,000 | At least 2% of the combined vehicles used for general and individual taxi services in the area. |

Note: Where a platform franchise business spans two or more business areas, it meets the minimum if at least one vehicle is secured in each area and the total number secured is at least the sum of the separate requirements for those areas.

2. Transportation platform standards: The operator must have the transportation platform prescribed by item 4 of Annex 6-2, as well as office space and permanent resident personnel.

rows.source_ko: [별표 6의4] 플랫폼운수종사자의 준수사항(제93조의8 관련)
rows.text_en:
[Attached Table 6-4] Compliance Requirements for Platform Transport Workers (Related to Article 93-8)

Compliance Duties of Platform Transport Workers (Annex 6-4, Article 93-8)

1. Before starting operation, check that the safety equipment, lighting, and related equipment of a vehicle used for platform transport are functioning normally to protect passengers and prevent accidents.
2. Notify the platform transport business operator when safe driving is not possible due to illness, fatigue, consumption of alcohol, or other reasons.
3. If a serious malfunction is discovered during operation, or there is another risk of an accident, stop driving immediately and take appropriate action.
4. If a driver discovers a road hazard while working, inform the next driver when ending or handing over driving duties.
5. If a passenger performs any of the following acts, restrain the act and give necessary instructions for safe operation and other passengers' convenience: (a) bringing explosives, flammable materials, or other dangerous goods likely to harm passengers onto the vehicle; (b) bringing an animal likely to injure or inconvenience passengers, except an assistance dog for a person with a disability or a pet kept in a dedicated carrying case; (c) bringing objects likely to block a vehicle entrance, exit, or passageway.
6. Immediately comply when a relevant public official requests presentation of a driver's license, identification document, or qualification certificate.
7. Where an accident causes death or injury, or the operation of a commercial vehicle is interrupted, take the measures appropriate to the accident circumstances among those specified in Article 41(1).
8. Comply with other directions given by the platform transport business operator under this Rule.
